description: A Google Mobile Ads custom event adapter that lets publishers serve Silverpush demand through their existing AdMob or Google Ad Manager mediation waterfall. It carries no third-party ad SDK of its own, so integration is a single dependency with no code changes, and the ad units it serves are resolved at runtime from a Silverpush-hosted configuration - inventory can be repointed without an app update. Supports banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial and native formats.
